_comment: Shared cross-platform known-answer vectors for my-secrect crypto v1. THE SAME inputs MUST produce THE SAME bytes in TypeScript (packages/crypto-adapters, libsodium-wrappers-sumo) and Rust (native/crypto-core, sodiumoxide/libsodium). If any value here changes, the format version must bump (see specs/encryption-format.md).
_generated: Computed 2026-11-17 with libsodium itself via PyNaCl 1.6.2 (bundled libsodium): nacl.pwhash.argon2id.kdf(outlen=32, opslimit=2, memlimit=67108864) and nacl.bindings.crypto_aead_xchacha20poly1305_ietf_encrypt. Determinism was verified by deriving each KEK twice. Reproduce with: cd native/crypto-core && cargo test --test vectors ; node --test tests/crypto-vectors/argon2id-vectors.test.mjs (after npm install). NEVER hand-edit an expected hex value to make a test pass — if a value mismatches, the implementation or the parameters are wrong.

xchacha20poly1305_ietf.note: ciphertext_hex is ciphertext || 16-byte Poly1305 tag (libsodium seal output). No additional data (AD is null everywhere in v1). Stored layout is nonce (24B) || ciphertext+tag.
